oracleRules.claimText: Exact expected claim or omission of its initial definite article The plus capitalization of the next ASCII letter. No other text variation is accepted.
oracleRules.sourceQuote: Exact expected quote; article omission never applies to quotations.
oracleRules.remainingFields: Exact category, claim count, action kind, target and body. Existing selection, citation, provenance, approval, canonical-effect and deduplication checks remain required.
oracleRules.rationale: The definite article does not alter the existing security-review referent, incomplete state or launch-blocking condition. Exact copying of prose is not required for the summary claim, while the supporting quote remains literal.
oracleRules.historicalEvidence: This is a new execution oracle. Original reviews.json and the failed v1 evidence remain unchanged and are not regraded.
